items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: LaRue was a good guy, and he catered to the musicians, a lot of musicians.

ctx.x: This type of a guy, and LaRue was a good guy, and he catered to the musicians, a lot of musicians. And Art would come in there every morning after he got out from work, just as dutifully like he was coming to work, after he got off from the Three Deuces.
And we would sit there until 8:00, 9:00 and 10:00 in the morning, listening to Art Tatum play. And then, he liked
